question: ‘Unladylike’ is a memoir by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Radhika Vaz**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unladylike** is a memoir written by **Radhika Vaz**.
 
• Radhika Vaz is a well-known comedian and writer, recognized for her bold and unapologetic approach to discussing gender and societal norms.
 
• In her memoir, Vaz shares her journey and experiences, providing a humorous yet insightful perspective on various aspects of life.
 
• The book has been praised for its candidness and the author's unique voice in addressing issues related to womanhood and personal growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Radhika Vaz** is also known for her work in stand-up comedy and has performed in various shows and festivals.
 
• Her comedy often tackles themes of gender, sexuality, and societal expectations, making her a prominent voice in contemporary comedy.
 
• In addition to her memoir, Vaz has contributed to various publications and platforms, sharing her insights and comedic take on life.
 
• Her work continues to inspire and entertain audiences, challenging conventional norms and encouraging open discussions on important issues.
